notes:
Summary: Went through a 6-week evaluation with a 2-week POC against sample traffic for reranking + embeddings. Ultimately closed-lost to Replicate (pricing + hosted SLA) after security raised KMS/HSM and data residency concerns and finance instituted a hiring freeze affecting 2025 budgets. Had parallel demos with Together and Fireworks; Replicate offered a faster turnkey path for hosted inference and cheaper committed pricing.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2024-11-12: Initial qualification call (Maya P.). Use case = realtime reranking for ad personalization; target p95 latency <50ms for 256-token contexts.
- 2024-11-20: Demo w/ SE (Ethan R.) — showed Redwood hosted API + Dedicated config. Customer liked routing/fallback ideas.
- 2024-12-05: POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_20241205_6c9a). Provided small dataset and sample prompts.
- 2024-12-18: Security deep-dive w/ tidalWave SecOps. Raised requirements: customer-managed KMS + HSM, audit log retention 7 years, EU data residency for subset of personal data.
- 2025-01-10: POC mid-point review — performance meet for embeddings but reranking p95 slightly above target under burst traffic. Suggested batching + KV cache tweaks.
- 2025-01-22: Final POC result call (ff_20250122_a14b). Redwood delivered acceptable perf but needed additional infra for HSM integration.
- 2025-02-03: Procurement pushes back — finance freeze for new infra in Q1; internal champion (Head of ML) promoted and bandwidth reduced.
- 2025-02-12: Competitive win notification — customer selected Replicate for immediate hosted rollout; Together still considered for private later.

Use-case / requirements notes (shorthand):
- Workload: high-throughput reranking + periodic embeddings refresh.
- Latency target: p95 <50ms (256 tokens). Throughput: 600 qps peak.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; prefer transparent unit pricing + committed discount.
- Model prefs: Llama-family & quantized variants acceptable; open to Redwood-verified model if latency/cost fits.
- Routing: want primary hosted, fallback to dedicated/pinned model for failures.
- Security: SSO/SAML required, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency for EU users only, audit logs retained 7y.

What went wrong / reasons for loss:
- Security team concluded Redwood Private integration timeline for HSM/KMS > 6 months — unacceptable for their roadmap.
- Finance instituted a hiring/budget freeze; cannot commit to Dedicated/reserved capacity in H1 2025.
- No strong internal champion after Head of ML reprioritized.
- Competitor advantage: Replicate offered quicker hosted onboarding + cheaper committed monthly price; Together showed promise for future private deployment but not immediate.

Sales notes and next steps:
- AE Maya: keep in CRM as closed-lost, tag as "watchlist-Q3".
- Ask: if Replicate experience shows regressions or performance problems, re-open conversation; offer a 90-day revisit with improved HSM integration roadmap.
- Short-term: provide a one-pager summarizing HSM/KMS roadmap and an estimated timeline to satisfy SecOps (attach to record).

Stated customer quote: "We need something turnkey now — security and timeline constraints are non-negotiable. It's not a 'no' to Redwood forever, just timing."

Attachments: drive links above, security notes in ticket SEC-1187, POC perf report in /drive/tidalwave/poc/poc-results-2025-01.pdf
